items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-04-23
items.q: He was living on the causeway at Marino's Motel, and he and I got to be buddy buddies for a while.

ctx.x: Freddie King came down here, and he was on the cause. He was living on the causeway at Marino's Motel, and he and I got to be buddy buddies for a while. He was here because his cause broke down.

items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: Freddie King went on and recorded it and made a national record... I don't know if Rick Records were ever paid any money from Freddie King.

ctx.x: Yeah. Now, the Double I Whammy was recorded for Rick, but Freddie King went on and recorded it and made a national record because it was number 17 on the survey, on the national charts. Uh huh. Now, I don't know if Rick Records were ever paid any money from Freddie King. Uh huh. I don't think because Freddie King claimed the song as it's on. Uh huh. Now, I have an attorney to take care of that.
They may have copyrighted it. Yeah.
